subject.title: [Analysis] Identify performance bottlenecks in native OpenClaw setup on constrained VPS

question: Should this remain a broad native-Linux VPS performance analysis/runbook issue, or should maintainers close it in favor of narrower latency-diagnostics trackers such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88812 and the bundle-tools/event-loop issues?
rationale: The codebase has partial diagnostics and several overlapping open trackers, but no single current item fully owns this exact native-VPS layer-by-layer analysis; deciding the permanent tracking shape is maintainer scope, not a source-only conclusion.

options.title: Keep as scoped runbook
options.body: Keep this issue open only after scoping a native-Linux measurement environment, layer list, and acceptance criteria, while routing code fixes to narrower trackers.

options.title: Fold into narrower trackers
options.body: Close this as superseded if maintainers decide the combination of reply-latency, bundle-tools, and event-loop trackers fully covers the remaining work.

options.title: Treat as deployment support
options.body: Close as support if maintainers do not want repository-owned performance analysis for this specific VPS configuration.

recommendation.title: Keep as scoped runbook
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open only after scoping a native-Linux measurement environment, layer list, and acceptance criteria, while routing code fixes to narrower trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: The current docs and broad performance/observability surfaces route through steipete's recent current-main history, and the choice is primarily repository tracking/product scope.
